items.title: Pilbara lithium shipments rise as spodumene concentrate prices stabilise
items.summary: Concentrate exports from Western Australian operations increased month-on-month, with buyers reporting firmer settlement levels for Q4 cargoes.
items.body:
Concentrate shipments from Pilbara lithium operations rose this month as spodumene prices stabilised across the region, according to port data compiled by demo-wire. Volumes recovered after a maintenance window at one of the region's export terminals finished ahead of schedule.

Traders said Q4 settlements for 6% spodumene concentrate have converged in a narrower band than earlier in the year, easing the margin uncertainty that dominated negotiations through the middle of the year. Several producers have kept output guidance unchanged.

Analysts caution that downstream conversion margins in China remain compressed, and that the pace of demand recovery from cathode makers will decide whether the price floor holds into next quarter. The report is demo content for the mining-brief-agent sample pipeline.

items.title: Pilgangoora expansion study advances to feasibility stage
items.summary: A pre-feasibility study for a brownfield expansion at the Pilgangoora lithium project has been upgraded, with a definitive feasibility study targeted for completion next year.
items.body:
The expansion concept for the Pilgangoora lithium operation has moved into the definitive feasibility stage, according to a demo project update. The study contemplates additional crushing and dense-media separation capacity alongside a debottlenecking of the existing concentrator.

A decision on the final scope is expected after metallurgical test work completes. The update said grid power and existing camp infrastructure are expected to be the main cost advantages relative to greenfield alternatives in the district.

This article is synthetic demo content bundled with mining-brief-agent; it does not describe events at any real project.

items.title: Lithium carbonate spot prices hold near two-month highs
items.summary: Battery-grade lithium carbonate assessments were little changed week-on-week, holding near their best levels since summer.
items.body:
Battery-grade lithium carbonate spot assessments held near two-month highs this week, with trade described as thin but balanced. Buyers covered near-term requirements while sellers showed little urgency at current levels.

Conversion economics from spodumene feedstock have improved modestly as concentrate settlements stabilised, though integrated producers still report thin margins outside of long-term contracts. Inventory at cathode plants remains the key swing factor cited by traders.

Demo content: figures and commentary here are illustrative and do not represent any real market assessment.
